title: Uniform polynomial-probability type rounding yields exact legal probes

statement.quantifiers: EVERY probability vector p on <=D coordinates, every n>=1 and energies 0<=h_j<=hmax. K=(D-1)hmax,C_D=(D-1)+D(D-1)².
statement.assertion: There exists count k summing n with exact multinomial mass p_type>=exp(-C_D)(n+1)^-D and |sum k_j h_j-n sum p_j h_j|<=K. Combined with top tilted vector and LA011: ng(c)-2s_h K-D log(n+1)-C_D<=-log p_n(nc)<=ng(c), simultaneously every c>=0; g(c)=inf_s>=0[log||e^-sH/2 BdagB e^-sH/2||+sc].
assumptions: Fixed finite D, probabilities may be arbitrarily small or zero.
Tilt geometry supplies a top vector of desired mean; hard contract of LA011 for detection consequence.
Nonlattice energies and degenerate energy levels allowed.

inputs: p,n,energy values; in application calibrated matrices and dual minimizing tilt.
outputs: One EXACT total-energy type with polynomial mass; uniform O(log n) remainder.
interface.precision: Explicit constants; no lower bound on nonzero p_j needed.
costs: Type projection succeeds p_type; subsequent legal local filter >=p_type, combined naive attempt >=p_type².
Repetition/coherent reference/driving work/amplitude precision charged; no scalable implementation bound.

proof_mechanism: Round nonmaximal np_j down, place remainder at maximal p_j>=1/D.
Bound n KL(q||p)<=C_D and use mode under q with <=(n+1)^D possible types.
Shift mean target by K/n; exact-energy type meets ceiling; tensor order and Gram identity yield remainder.
obstructions: Do not charge only accepted probe energy while dropping probabilistic preparation.
A typical-window construction without exact type legality does not prove this hard-support result.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire comparable uniformly probable rounding and support-preserving inverse before claiming logarithmic remainder.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
